title: Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis electroporation
author: Andrew J. M. Swafford
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.88xhzxn
materials: Make an appropriate volume of Paraformaldehyde fixation buffer.

steps.title: Prepare SM buffer (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL SM buffer (must be ≤7 days old) using: 5 mL 50 mM KCl (autoclaved), 750 µL 1 M Na‑phosphate buffer pH 7.2 (filter‑sterilized), 7.5 mL 100 mM Na‑phosphate buffer (filter‑sterilized), 0.338 g MgCl₂ (filter‑sterilized), 0.228 g sodium succinate dibasic hexahydrate, 36.75 mL D‑mannitol, and sterile water to volume.

steps.title: Chill reagents and media
steps.instruction: Place fixation buffer, growth media, and Bonner’s salts on ice. Measure the required amount of autoclaved growth media into an appropriate flask.

steps.title: Resuspend synchronized cells in SM
steps.instruction: Transfer synchronized B. dendrobatidis spores to 50 mL conical tubes and resuspend in 10 mL SM buffer; combine suspensions if multiple tubes are needed.

steps.title: First centrifugation and supernatant discard
steps.instruction: Spin at 2500 rpm, 4 °C for 5 min; immediately discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in SM (5 mL)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL SM buffer.

steps.title: Second centrifugation and discard
steps.instruction: Spin again at 2500 rpm, 4 °C for 5 min; discard the supernatant immediately.

steps.title: Adjust cell suspension volume for cuvettes
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in SM buffer so that each cuvette will receive 100 µL SM (i.e., 100 µL SM per cuvette).

steps.title: Count and adjust cell concentration
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration and adjust to 1 × 10⁷–2 × 10⁷ cells / mL; dilute if spores are overly concentrated.

steps.title: Prepare control and experimental tubes/cuvettes
steps.instruction:
Prepare the following in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and 0.2 cm gap cuvettes:
- E‑D‑ (electroporation control, no dextran): 100 µL SM + 100 µL cell suspension.
- E‑D+ (dextran control, no pulse): 100 µL dextran solution + 100 µL cell suspension.
- E+D‑ (pulse, no dextran): 100 µL SM + 100 µL cell suspension in a 0.2 cm cuvette.
- E+D+ (pulse + dextran): 100 µL dextran solution + 100 µL cell suspension in a 0.2 cm cuvette.
Repeat this preparation for all cuvettes, also pipetting the control Eppendorf tubes even though they will not receive a pulse.

steps.title: Ice incubation of samples
steps.instruction: Place all prepared tubes and cuvettes on ice for approximately 10 minutes.

steps.title: Set electroporation parameters
steps.instruction: Program the electroporator for a square‑wave protocol: 1000 V, 2 pulses, 5 s interval, using 0.2 cm (2 mm) gap cuvettes.

steps.title: Perform electroporation and immediate cooling
steps.instruction: Insert each cuvette, electroporate according to the program, then immediately remove the cuvette and place it on ice.

steps.title: Add chilled growth media to cuvettes
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL chilled growth media to each cuvette and gently pipette up and down to mix the cells just before electroporation.

steps.title: Transfer to conical tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the contents of each tube and cuvette into separate 15 mL conical tubes.

steps.title: Wash cells twice with Bonner’s salts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the conical tubes (conditions described later), discard the supernatant, add 5 mL Bonner’s salts, mix, and repeat the centrifugation and discard step once more (total of two washes).

steps.title: Add Bonner’s salts (600 µL, 4 °C)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Bonner’s salts (pre‑chilled to 4 °C) to each tube.

steps.title: Add equal volume fixation buffer
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of fixation buffer (4.8 % PFA, 9 mM sucrose, 50 mM sodium phosphate, pH 7.2) to each tube.

steps.title: Ice incubation for 15 min
steps.instruction: Immediately place the tubes on ice and leave them for 15 minutes (this incubation is in addition to the subsequent centrifugation time).

steps.title: Centrifuge at room temperature
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2200 rpm, room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend in Bonner’s salts (400 µL)
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 400 µL Bonner’s salts.

steps.title: Quantify or store samples
steps.instruction: Immediately quantify the cells by flow cytometry, or wrap the tubes in foil and store at 4 °C for up to 4 hours.
